source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VIII, Section 808

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VIII Section 808, what is the minimum window opening area required for a habitable room in a Group A dwelling?

options.text: At least 10 percent of the floor area of the room, with a minimum opening of 1.00 sq.m
At least 15 percent of the floor area of the room, with a minimum opening of 1.20 sq.m
At least 12.5 percent of the floor area of the room, with a minimum opening of 1.50 sq.m
At least 5 percent of the floor area of the room, with a minimum opening of 0.60 sq.m

proposed.rationale: Section 808 requires window openings in habitable rooms of Group A dwellings to be at least 10 percent of the floor area of the room, and in no case less than 1.00 sq.m. The window must open directly to a court, yard, public space, or air shaft.
proposed.explanation: The 10 percent rule and the 1.00 sq.m absolute minimum are two separate conditions; both must be satisfied. The opening must face a genuine outside air volume, not a covered or enclosed space.
